content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"countObjects(kind=dirt, crop=Parsnip, watered=true)","op":">=","value":6}]},"modes":[{"id":"field-work","priority":1,"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push([x, y]); } } for (const [x, y] of tiles) { b.log('tilling ' + x + ',' + y); let r = await b.workTile(x, y, 0, 'ControllerX'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('till fail ' + r.detail); } await b.wait(150); b.log('planting ' + x + ',' + y); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 2, 'ControllerA'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('plant fail ' + r.detail); } await b.wait(150); b.log('watering ' + x + ',' + y); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 1, 'ControllerX'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('water fail ' + r.detail); } await b.wait(150); } }","check":"async (b) => { const obs = await b.observe(); const m = obs.match(/countObjects\\(kind=dirt, crop=Parsnip, watered=true\\)\\s*[:=]\\s*(\\d+)/i); const n = m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0; return { ok: n >= 6, detail: 'watered parsnips: ' + n }; }"}]}
